create_Mesh_from_vertices_faces: create a Mesh object from PyTorch vertex and face tensors with optional surface or vertex textures
load_Mesh_from_obj: create a Mesh object from a .obj file with optional texture loading and normalization
compute_surface_normals: compute normalized surface normals for each face using cross product of face vertex vectors
fill_back_Mesh_faces: duplicate mesh faces in reverse winding order to render both front and back faces
voxelize_Mesh: voxelize a mesh into a 3D grid by normalizing face vertices and running voxelization
